ETH gave back all its post-election rebound: less than 2% above the 11/5 low, and ETF outflows have resumed for two straight days. I’m still not calling this a bottom

That surge toward 2,450 on 11/4 came fast—and was completely erased just as quickly. Among the three major coins, ETH has pulled back the most from its high, and its relative strength against BTC has faded too.

Binance spot data (11/7, 23:04 Taipei time): ETH around 2,245, up 1.0% over 24 hours, with a range of 2,210–2,254; BTC around 75,916, up 0.8%, with a range of 74,888–76,250. ETH closed at 2,424.61 on the 11/4 daily candle, with a high of 2,450; on 11/5, it closed back at 2,238.01, after hitting an intraday low of 2,206.28. The current price is about 7.4% below the 11/4 close and about 8.4% below the 11/4 high—just 1.8% above the 11/5 low. ETH/BTC is around 0.0296, down about 1.9% from its 11/4 close of 0.03013.

The fund flows hardly support the idea that “institutions are buying ETH again.” Farside data shows that after U.S. spot ETH ETFs saw consecutive net outflows of $139.7 million and $85.3 million on 11/2 and 11/3, they recorded a $53 million net inflow on 11/4 (ETHA +$32.8 million, while ETHB still saw $22.4 million in outflows). Then came a $99.9 million net outflow on 11/5, followed by another $93.3 million outflow on 11/6 (ETHA -$90.8 million). Across the first five trading days of November, net outflows totaled about $365.2 million, with only one of those five days seeing a net inflow.

The macro backdrop hasn’t given risk assets any relief either. The BLS reported 165,000 new jobs in October and an unemployment rate of 4.1%. Employment was stronger than the recent average, and over the weekend ETH just hovered around 2,200–2,250—there was no “data is out, so prices are rising” move.

What does this mean?
The 11/4 surge looks more like a short squeeze/risk-positioning rebound after the election results came in, rather than ETH outperforming on its own. Price first touched 2,450, but flows only showed a net inflow for one day; over the next two days, nearly $193 million flowed back out. The daily candle also gave back the rebound, and ETH/BTC fell along with it. A genuine bottom isn’t about briefly touching 2,400 intraday—it’s about whether inflows can persist and price can move away from the lower end of the 2,200 area.

My view: ETH is worth watching, but I’m not ready to call this rebound a bottom. Here are the three conditions I’m watching: the daily close holds above the 11/5 low of 2,206 and gets back above 2,300; U.S. spot ETH ETFs see at least one more day of net inflows, ideally with ETHA turning positive too; and ETH/BTC climbs back above around 0.030 (near its 11/4 close). Until all three conditions are met, today is just “giving back the rebound and hovering near the lows,” not “the start of a rally.”

ETH 选举反抽吐光了：离 11/5 低点不到 2%，ETF 又连流出两天，我还不把它当企稳

11/4 冲到 2450 附近的那根，来得猛，吐得也干净。三大主流里，ETH 从高点回撤最深，相对 BTC 的强度也一起退回去了。

Binance 现货数据（11/7 23:04 台北时间）：ETH 约 2,245，24 小时 +1.0%，区间 2,210–2,254；BTC 约 75,916，+0.8%，区间 74,888–76,250。11/4 日线收盘 ETH 2,424.61、高点 2,450；11/5 日线收盘回到 2,238.01，盘中低点 2,206.28。现价相对 11/4 收盘约 -7.4%，相对 11/4 高点约 -8.4%，只比 11/5 低点高约 1.8%。ETH/BTC 约 0.0296，相对 11/4 收盘 0.03013 回落约 1.9%。

资金面更谈不上“机构又回来买 ETH 了”。Farside 显示，美国现货 ETH ETF 11/2、11/3 连续净流出 1.397 亿、8,530 万美元后，11/4 录得净流入 5,300 万美元（ETHA +3,280 万，但 ETHB 仍流出 2,240 万）；紧接着 11/5 净流出 9,990 万美元，11/6 再净流出 9,330 万美元（ETHA -9,080 万）。11 月前五个交易日合计约净流出 3.652 亿美元，五天里只有一天是净流入。

宏观上也没有给风险资产松绑。BLS 10 月非农新增就业 16.5 万，失业率 4.1%；就业强于近期均值，周末盘面只是在 2,200–2,250 附近磨，没有出现“数据落地就抬头”的走势。

这代表什么？
11/4 的上冲，更像是选举落地后的空头挤压／风险回补，不是 ETH 单独走强。价格先摸到 2450，资金只给出“一天”的净流入，接下来两天就吐出近 1.93 亿；日线也把反弹还回去，ETH/BTC 跟着回落。真正的企稳，不是盘中摸一下 2400，而是资金能不能连续买、价格能不能离开 2200 这一带的下沿。

我的判断：ETH 值得盯着，但我还不会把这次反抽当成企稳。我写给自己的观察条件是三个：日线收盘守住 11/5 低点 2,206 上方，并重新站上 2,300；美国现货 ETH ETF 至少再出现一天净流入，且最好 ETHA 也转正；ETH/BTC 重新站上 0.030 附近（接近 11/4 收盘）。三个条件都没出现之前，今天只是“反弹回吐、贴着低点磨”，不是“开始涨”。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “rolling positions” has been all the rage lately. The stories are all the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times
and multiply it dozens of times. Today, let's talk about the part they don't tell you.

[What rolling positions involve] Unrealized profits aren't cashed out; they're treated as risk capital for new positions, and used to keep opening trades.
It's essentially using the market's money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astounding; the moment it stops, unrealized gains
can go from dozens of points in profit to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

[The Math] The essence of rolling positions is “being right repeatedly.” Suppose each trade has a 60% win rate; winning four times in a row
has only a 13% probability. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

【Title: Just said hash rate had peaked, and now miners are suddenly losing money】
Just two days ago, I said Bitcoin's hash rate had peaked and been declining for 374 days. Now miners' output has suddenly dropped by 30%, while the hash rate has held steady.

In a post from two days ago, I mentioned that Bitcoin's hash rate had been at its peak for 374 days, and miners' costs were getting higher and higher. BitFuFu mined 137 BTC this month, 30 fewer than in September, but its hash rate is still about the same, staying above 19.5 EH/s. The company says the drop in output may be due to rising electricity costs or Bitcoin's price falling too sharply, leaving miners operating at a loss. In short: miners' costs are rising faster than the coins their machines can mine.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Miners losing money may not sell their coins right away, but this signal is reinforcing the market's expectation that hash rate has peaked, especially since these are output figures from a major mining company.
- Medium term: If miners keep losing money, they may invest less in new mining machines, which could affect Bitcoin's supply over the long run. In the short term, though, everyone's more focused on whether Bitcoin's price will really fall far enough to push them past the breaking point.

My take
This is neutral to slightly bearish, but it won't directly set off a hash rate collapse. The key is whether Bitcoin can hold above $75,916. If it falls below that level, more miners may start heading for the exit. Go easy on me if I'm wrong. I'm only testing the waters with a small position myself. I'm about 70% confident in this call; I'll leave the remaining 30% to the market.

【标题：刚说算力见顶，矿工突然亏钱了】
前两天刚说过比特币算力见顶回落持续374天，现在矿工产量突然降了30%，但算力还稳着。

前两天帖子说过，比特币算力见顶已经持续374天，矿工们的成本越来越高。BitFuFu这个月采出了137BTC，比9月少了30个，但他们的算力还是老样子，没低于19.5EH/s。他们自己说，产量降可能是电费涨价或者比特币价格跌得太狠，让矿工开始亏钱了。一句话翻译：挖矿的兄弟们，成本涨得比矿机跑出来的币还快。

对市场的影响
- 短期：矿工亏钱可能不会马上抛币，但这个信号让市场觉得算力见顶的预期越来越重，毕竟这是头部矿商的产量数据。
- 中期：如果矿工持续亏钱，可能会减少新矿机的投入，长期看可能影响比特币供应。但短期内，大家更关注比特币价格是不是真的要跌到他们撑不住的程度。

我的判断
这事儿中性偏利空，但不会直接引爆算力崩溃的剧情。关键看比特币能不能稳住$75,916以上的价格，如果跌破这个位，可能会有更多矿工开始出逃。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试，这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场。

Bitcoin's hashrate has been declining from its peak for 374 days, setting a new record

Bitcoin mining difficulty has remained below its all-time high for 374 consecutive days, which is why miners are still holding back

Miners are like players in an ever-evolving game: Bitcoin mining. The difficulty is the game's difficulty level—the higher it is, the harder the game. Over the past 375 days, the difficulty hasn't exceeded its previous record, suggesting that not many new miners have joined, or that some veteran miners are leaving. It's not that miners have suddenly gotten lazy; they're simply getting better at calculating costs. Electricity is the biggest expense, and with power prices rising and mining machines getting more expensive, they won't expand unless it's profitable.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Changes in miners' sentiment may indirectly affect market sentiment, but won't cause immediate price fluctuations
- Medium term: This may indicate that the market is in a state of supply-demand balance, which could help stabilize prices

My take
This is more like checking the market's thermometer. For now, it shows neither a fever nor a drop in temperature. Miners' actions reflect their expectations for future electricity and Bitcoin prices. If electricity prices keep rising, or Bitcoin's price stays below a certain level for a prolonged period, miners may continue to leave. But in the short term, this indicator has a limited direct impact on prices. Feel free to correct me if I'm wrong—I'm only trying it out with a small position myself.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position. How should you do it? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized gains is a recipe for landing on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramiding.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】A reverse pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is all at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, every move goes wrong.

ETH searches surge | Geth proposes a simulated-signing interface | First, see whether $2,249 can hold

My stance is to wait and see, with a cautious bias. Binance Square’s Most Searched list over the past six hours marked ETH as a Rapid Riser, indicating rising interest, but search activity alone is not buying pressure. On November 7, a new PR, #36081, was opened in Geth’s official repository. It proposes allowing programs that use StateProcessor to customize transaction signers during simulation and testing. The proposal is still Open, has not been merged, and has not been deployed to the Ethereum mainnet. The original request, #32782, was submitted by the Tenderly team. The background is that the existing processor performs full signature verification by default when simulating blocks, while some account-simulation scenarios need to specify the sender. The PR says the default signer will continue to follow the existing logic. Describing “customization in a simulated environment” as “the mainnet no longer verifies signatures” would conflate a tool interface with consensus rules.

The impact of this development on the crypto market is more of a long-term story: if the tool eventually matures, simulators could make it easier to test complex transactions, account impersonation, and rollbacks, benefiting the developer experience and risk checks. But the code is still awaiting review, and it will not directly increase ETH burns, staking yields, or ETF inflows today. Nor can it, by itself, explain short-term price movements. I care more about whether the market is willing to pay a premium for this kind of development improvement, while also checking whether macro interest-rate expectations and spot-market flows are supportive. Employment and CPI discussions are prominent on Binance Square’s trending list, and policy expectations may weigh on volatile assets first. This is only a risk framework; unpublished data must not be presented as if it had already been released.

At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,242. The rolling daily open was $2,235, with an intraday low of about $2,235 and a high of about $2,249. The price is slightly above the daily open, but remains below the intraday high; I cannot attribute this rebound to the Geth proposal. In the short term, first watch whether trading above $2,249–$2,250 can be sustained, then watch support at $2,235. If the price breaks out but quickly falls back below $2,235, search activity looks more like attention than effective demand. If it falls below $2,200, the bullish scenario needs to be reassessed. These price levels are trading conditions, not predictions.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long, with a planned position cap of 0.3% of total capital and no leverage. 当前市场情绪偏向恐慌。比特币恐惧贪婪指数跌至三个月最低水平，反映出投资者信心严重不足。美国十月非农就业数据大幅超预期，新增十六万五千人远超预期的六万五千人，失业率降至百分之四点一，这直接推高了美联储十二月加息的预期概率至约百分之七十八。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Survive Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 U per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re almost as good as finished.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

Moscow Exchange to Launch Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading on December 1

Russia’s Moscow Exchange will begin trading Bitcoin and Ethereum on December 1, marking the country’s first regulated access to the crypto market through a major financial exchange.

Unqualified retail investors will face an annual purchase limit of 300,000 rubles per broker and will need to pass a competency test before gaining access. The launch is structured as a pilot program, suggesting a gradual rollout rather than immediate full access.

The move aligns with Russia’s broader push to bring crypto activity into a regulated framework, giving institutional and retail participants a state-sanctioned venue for digital asset exposure.

U.S. Treasury Orders Financial Institutions to Cut Off M3XC Exchange

The U.S. Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has issued an order directing U.S. financial institutions to stop processing fund transfers to or from M3XC Exchange.

FinCEN alleges that the platform facilitated at least $16 billion in transactions related to sanctions evasion, cybercrime, and other illicit activities. The transactions in question span the period from May 2021 to May 2026, according to the order.

The action effectively cuts M3XC off from the U.S. financial system, placing it alongside a small number of exchanges that have faced similar Treasury enforcement actions. M3XC is registered in Seychelles and does not hold a U.S. operating license.

【$3.1 billion still untouched on-chain—where is the risk hiding?】

Elliptic found that the $3.1 billion stolen from Binance was scattered across more than 20,000 wallets and 16 chains, with the bulk in ETH and BTC still not laundered. It’s like a batch of contaminated goods: leaving them on-chain doesn’t make the risk disappear.

This gets to the “smart contract invariants” in the ETH upgrade. Think of them as warehouse access controls: the total must add up, balances must be correct after deposits and withdrawals, and repeated calls must not create loopholes. Developers are investigating eight invariants related to Glamsterdam; until the risks are resolved, the Hoodi fork won’t move forward.

What does this mean in practice, and who is affected? Wallets, exchanges, DeFi, and users of the upgrade bear the costs of bugs, freezes, and delays, while developers have to conduct more audits and retesting. Does the business case hold up? One less marketing opportunity in the short term, but fewer losses and less erosion of trust in the long term—that’s a trade-off that makes sense.

With ETH at $2,237 and the Fear Index at 25, I wouldn’t buy in based on upgrade expectations. I’d focus on testing, fixes, migration, and changes to fees. Narratives can drive prices up, but only security can underpin value.

Remember: when evaluating an ETH upgrade, first ask whether the rules hold up, then whether the features work.

Is delaying Glamsterdam a necessary brake, or a sign that the team can’t deliver? Would you like to learn more about security audits or the value of the upgrade?

Adding to the position while sitting on unrealized losses: A whale withdrew around 13,000 ETH from Binance in a week

It only shows that a large investor is willing to keep building a position at this price and is, for now, prepared to ride out the unrealized loss.

What to watch next: whether this address continues withdrawing ETH from exchanges, whether flows into and out of spot ETH ETFs shift in the same direction, and whether the whale suddenly dumps back onto the order book if the unrealized loss grows. 链上监测显示，地址 0x4AB7 近一周累计买入约 13077 枚 ETH，合计约 2995 万美元；其中约两小时前（港时约 20:27 前后）又从币安提出 3300 枚，约 741 万美元。同步数据称这批仓位均价约 2290 美元，按当时价已浮亏约 68 万美元——人还在加，账上先红着。

跟持币和观望的人直接相关：大额从交易所提到自托管，短期会减少盘口可卖供给，但单笔巨鲸动作不等于见底，更不能当买卖信号。它只说明有大资金在这个价位愿意继续建仓，且暂时愿意扛浮亏。

接下来要确认：这地址还会不会继续从交易所提币、ETH 现货 ETF 资金流是否同步转向，以及浮亏扩大后会不会突然砸回盘口。别把「有人加仓」听成「底部确认」。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling out of a position: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here’s the scaling-out approach I’ve been using.

【Three stages】First stage: when price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 and lock in some gains.
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: when price reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), take another 1/3 off. Third stage: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if price breaks below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you close the whole position too early, you’ll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you’ll often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place your stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out constantly; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the setup is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.

First, the hardest numbers: $BTC  is now at 75,907, down 0.19% over 24 hours. From 01:00 to 20:00, all 20 hourly closes stayed above 75,568—not one fell below it. The reversal mentioned this morning still hadn’t been invalidated by evening.

But holding a level and breaking higher are two different things. The 16:00 close at 76,195 was today’s high; after that, price drifted down to 75,878. Hourly trading volume was down to just $12–17 million, nowhere near the massive $181 million candle at 23:00. $ETH 2,242 and SOL at 89.80 were also going nowhere. Funding rates were 0.0048% for BTC and 0.0054% for ETH—basically flat. Open interest was about 3.448 million contracts for BTC and 6.82 million for ETH, both slightly down from midday. No one is getting squeezed on leverage, and no one is betting on direction.

Price action and fund flows are still at odds, and neither won out today: ETFs saw $411.9 million in outflows on Friday, with net outflows of about $910 million year to date; IBIT had six straight days of outflows. Yet price held firmly at 75,568. Liquidations totaled about $709 million over 24 hours, including $572 million in long positions (CoinGlass via CoinEdition)—far less than Thursday’s $1 billion wipeout. The market has shifted from capitulation back to grinding out a bottom.

Altcoins were cleanly split today: ONE was the only one still standing, up 30.3% over 24 hours on $31.9 million in trading volume. Three hourly closes from 18:00 to 20:00 held above 0.0018, and the price touched 0.00209 intraday. But as always, no clear new catalyst for the day has been found—think carefully before chasing the rally.

Everything else that had risen during the day gave up its gains by evening. ACT was up as much as 23.4% in the afternoon, but closed at 0.01014 at 20:00, back below 0.01138; its intraday break above the previous high is being treated as a brief wick through. ZEC sold off on volume of $10.93 million at 18:00, breaking below 1,300 and closing at 1,287. CYBER closed at 0.308 at 19:00, below the 0.31 low. LSK closed at 0.1799 at 19:00, after setting another intraday low at 0.1772. HUMA also tested a new low at 0.0123. A rally without a catalyst to support it fades much faster than it rises.

The biggest overnight variable is October CPI, due Tuesday at 21:30 Beijing time: the market expects 0.3% headline and 0.2% core, but the Cleveland Fed’s estimate today puts core at just 0.21%—right on the 0.25% rounding threshold. It could round to 0.2% or 0.3%; a tiny difference, but an important one. The probability of a rate hike in December is now around 75%. There’s no year-over-year figure to look at this time because prices weren’t collected during last October’s shutdown; only the month-over-month figure is available.

Two other stories have no new developments. The MEXC notice has still not appeared in the Federal Register as of Friday evening Eastern time, so the 30-day countdown has not started. Separately, a single-source report says some USDT withdrawals over MEXC networks have been paused. The official explanation is routine maintenance, and a causal link to FinCEN has not been confirmed—so I’m noting it without drawing conclusions. GOPAX remains halted for a second day, with no timeline for resuming trading.

My view: don’t bet on direction over the weekend. The fact that 75,568 held for 20 candles is real, but so is falling volume and a lower center of gravity. Let’s be clear about the invalidation levels: only an hourly close above 77,620 would open the door to further upside for the reversal; a close back below 75,568 would weaken the reversal and put the 74,888 low back in play. Until Tuesday’s CPI comes out, watch more and trade less within the range.

A reminder: this is just my personal market commentary, not investment advice, and there are no guarantees about whether prices will rise or fall.

content:
BTC 20 根收盘守住 75568，量却缩到 1200 万：周末不赌方向，周二 21:30 的 CPI 才是裁判

先说最硬的数：$BTC 现在 75,907，24 小时 -0.19%。从凌晨 01:00 到晚上 20:00，整整 20 根 1 小时收盘全站在 75,568 上方，一根都没掉下去。早盘说的反转，到晚上还没被证伪。

但守住和攻上去是两回事。16:00 收盘 76,195 是今天高点，之后一路阴跌到 75,878，小时成交只剩 1,200–1,700 万美元，跟凌晨 23:00 那根 1.81 亿美元的天量没法比。$ETH 2,242、SOL 89.80，也都在原地磨。资金费率 BTC 0.0048%、ETH 0.0054%，基本贴零；未平仓 BTC 约 344.8 万张、ETH 约 682 万张，都比午间微降。没人挤杠杆，也没人下注方向。

价格和资金面还在打架，打了一整天没分胜负：周五 ETF 流出 4.119 亿美元、年内净流出约 9.1 亿，IBIT 六连流出；价格却死守 75,568 不动。24 小时爆仓约 7.09 亿美元、多头占 5.72 亿（CoinGlass 经 CoinEdition），比周四 10 亿美元的踩踏小多了，市场已从踩踏切回磨底。

山寨今天分化得很干净：站着的只剩 ONE 一个，24 小时 +30.3%、成交额 3,190 万美元，18:00–20:00 三根收盘守住 0.0018，盘中摸到 0.00209；但还是那句话，没找到当日明确新催化剂，追高自己掂量。

其余白天涨过的，晚上全缴械了：ACT 午后一度 +23.4%，20:00 收 0.01014，跌回 0.01138 下方，盘中破前高按刺破处理；ZEC 18:00 放量 1,093 万美元砸穿 1,300，收 1,287；CYBER 19:00 收 0.308，跌破 0.31 低点；LSK 19:00 收 0.1799，盘中 0.1772 再创新低；HUMA 0.0123 也再探新低。没有催化剂托着的一波，退潮比涨潮快得多。

隔夜最大的变量在周二 21:30（北京时间）的 10 月 CPI：市场预期整体 +0.3%、核心 +0.2%，但克利夫兰联储今测核心只有 0.21%，正好卡在 0.25% 的四舍五入线上——0.2% 还是 0.3%，一线之差。12 月加息概率已约 75%。这次没有同比数字可看，去年 10 月停摆没采价，只看环比。

另外两条线没新进展：MEXC 的联邦公报截至美东周五晚间仍未刊登，30 天倒计时没启动；另有单源消息称 MEXC 部分网络 USDT 提现暂停，官方口径是常规维护、与 FinCEN 的因果没证实，先记一笔不下结论。GOPAX 仍停牌第二天、无恢复时间表。

我的看法：周末不赌方向。75,568 守了 20 根是事实，但量缩、重心下移也是事实。失效位写清楚：1 小时收盘站上 77,620，反转才谈向上打开；收盘跌回 75,568 下方，反转打折、看 74,888 低点重测。周二 CPI 出来之前，区间里多看少动。

提醒一下：以上只是我个人的盘面记录，不是投资建议，涨跌都不保证。

Geth sync subscription fix pending review | Not a mainnet outage | Wait for ETH to hold above 2,251

My stance is to keep waiting. On November 6, a PR, #36074, appeared in the Ethereum execution client Geth repository to address an issue where sync status subscriptions could end up waiting on each other when unsubscribing; the corresponding issue, #36044, describes the code path and reproduction conditions. The submitter describes a relatively narrow race condition: if a subscription disconnects at the same time as a status broadcast, the relevant goroutines may get stuck, affecting subsequent sync status notifications from that node. The PR is still Open and awaiting review by code owners; the page also says it has not been deployed. This is a problem report and proposed fix in client development—not evidence that the Ethereum mainnet has stopped, that consensus has failed, or that user funds have been stolen. It should not be described as a fix already shipped in an official release, either.

Why should market accounts still pay attention to details like this? Exchanges, wallets, and infrastructure services rely on their own nodes and monitoring systems. If the subscription mechanism gets stuck, operators may receive sync status updates later, affecting troubleshooting and recovery; the actual impact, however, also depends on how it is used, how likely it is to occur, monitoring redundancy, and node versions. Its implications for ETH are more a variable in long-term reliability and operating costs than a source of new spot demand today. We should keep watching to see whether maintainers approve it, whether the code is merged, whether a subsequent release includes the fix, and whether any production incidents are disclosed. The submitter's local tests passing is no substitute for mainnet operating records.

The market has yet to show a strong event-driven reaction. At the time of checking Kraken, ETH/USD was around $2,238.66, with an intraday open of $2,235.40 and a range of $2,235.39 to $2,249.20; the 24-hour high was about $2,250.60, and the current price remains below it. Farside's tally showed net outflows of about $93.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 6, indicating that institutional channels did not provide sustained net buying over the most recent day. But fund data from the previous trading day is not the same as spot selling right now. Current trending topics on Binance Square mostly center on jobs, CPI, and BTC volatility; there is no rising topic directly corresponding to this Geth PR, so I won't force an unrelated tag. The Fed's current target rate remains 3.75% to 4%, and macro risk appetite may also outweigh a client-side change.

If I were trading, I would sit this one out for now, with a 0% position; the only direction I would consider is an unleveraged spot long. I would consider allocating at most 0.3% of my account only if ETH first breaks above $2,250.60, holds on a retest, and volume does not shrink noticeably. The first target is $2,280, where I would sell half; the second target is $2,310. I would close the remaining position if it falls back below $2,250.60 and weakens. I would set a hard stop-loss below $2,215 after entry and exit immediately if it is hit. If the price first breaks below the 24-hour low of $2,201.26 and fails to recover, the long plan is invalidated. If an official follow-up later discloses broader service impacts from this issue, I would also immediately suspend the plan and reassess. Waiting for code review and price confirmation is more disciplined than treating “proposed fix” as “good news delivered.”

Sources: Geth official repository PR #36074及issue #36044, Kraken ETH/USD, Farside ETH fund flows, and the Fed's October statement.

Geth同步订阅修补待审查｜不是主网故障｜ETH未站稳2251先观望

我的态度是继续观望。以太坊执行客户端Geth仓库11月6日出现PR #36074，处理同步状态订阅在取消订阅时可能互相等待的问题；对应的issue #36044给出代码路径和复现条件。提交者描述的是一个范围较窄的竞态：订阅断开恰好碰上状态广播，相关协程可能卡住，影响该节点后续同步状态通知。PR目前仍是Open，等待代码所有者审查，页面也标注没有部署。这是客户端开发中的问题报告与拟议修补，不是以太坊主网已经停摆、共识出错或用户资产被盗的证据，更不能写成修复已经随正式版推送。

这类细节为何仍值得市场账号关注？交易所、钱包和基础设施服务依赖自己的节点及其监控系统。若订阅机制卡住，运营者可能更迟收到同步状态变化，排查和恢复效率受影响；但实际影响还取决于使用方式、触发概率、监控冗余与节点版本。它对ETH的传导更像是长期可靠性与运维成本的变量，而不是今天新增一笔现货需求。需要继续看维护者是否批准、代码是否合并、后续版本是否包含修补，以及是否有生产环境事故披露。提交者的本地测试通过，也不能替代主网运行记录。

市场暂未给出事件驱动的强反应。查询Kraken时ETH/USD约2238.66美元，当日开盘2235.40，日内区间2235.39至2249.20，24小时上沿约2250.60；现价仍低于上沿。Farside汇总的11月6日美国ETH现货基金净流出约9330万美元，说明机构通道最近一天并未提供持续净买盘，但基金前一交易日数据也不是此刻现货抛单。币安广场当前趋势榜主要围绕就业、CPI和BTC波动，尚无与该Geth PR直接对应的上升话题，我不会硬贴无关标签。美联储目前利率目标仍为3.75%至4%，宏观风险偏好也可能压过一项客户端改动。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，仓位0%；方向只考虑无杠杆现货多头。只有ETH先突破2250.60美元、回踩站稳且成交量没有明显缩小，我才考虑投入账户资金最多0.3%。第一目标看2280美元，到位减半；第二目标看2310美元，余仓若重新跌回2250.60并走弱就平仓。入场后的硬止损设在2215美元下方，触及直接离场。若先跌破2201.26美元的24小时低点且不能收复，做多计划作废。若官方后续披露该问题造成更广泛服务影响，也立即暂停计划，重新评估。等待代码审查和价格确认，比把“拟修复”当成“利好落地”更符合纪律。

以太坊市场深度分析：企稳回升中的结构性机会

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月七日上午十一时，以太坊现货报价二千二百四十五点零五美元，二十四小时内微涨百分之零点二八。价格在二千二百四十二美元至二千二百五十一美元的狭窄区间内运行，整体呈现横盘整理态势。

从小时K线来看，以太坊在过去五个周期内呈现小幅震荡格局。开盘价从二千二百四十五点九八美元逐步回落至二千二百四十三点二五美元，每根K线的上下影线较短，显示多空双方在当前价位达成暂时平衡。成交量方面，第三个周期出现放量至三千二百九十六枚ETH，随后逐步回落至二千二百一十四枚，量能递减暗示市场观望情绪较浓。

布林带指标显示上轨位于二千二百五十四点八四美元，中轨位于二千二百四十一九一点四五美元，下轨位于二千二百二十八点九九美元。当前价格运行在中轨上方，距离上轨约十美元，短期波动空间有限。值得注意的是，以太坊在宏观数据公布后表现出一定的韧性，并未跟随比特币大幅下挫，显示出独立行情的特征。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日移动平均线位于二千二百四十六点三六美元，二十五日移动平均线位于二千二百四十点三六美元，短期均线仍在长期均线上方，维持微弱的多头排列。但九十九日均线位于二千二百九十九点三六美元，对价格构成较强的上方压力。指数移动平均线中，七日EMA已跌至二千二百四十五点四七美元，低于二十五日EMA的二千二百四十六点四二美元，短期均线出现死叉迹象。

MACD指标显示DIF线位于负二点零五，信号线位于负四点零五，柱状图为正二点零零。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状图连续五个周期为正且呈收窄趋势，表明空头力量正在逐步衰竭。若柱状图继续收窄至零轴附近并翻红，将形成底背离信号，为反弹提供技术支撑。

RSI六周期指标降至四十三点五四，已进入中性偏弱区域。十二周期RSI为四十七点零七，二十四周期RSI为四十三点七一，三条RSI线均处于五十下方，显示中短期动能偏弱。KDJ指标中K线降至四十七点四三，D线位于五十九点四七，J线降至二十三点三三，J线已进入超卖区域，暗示短期存在技术性反弹需求。

综合十五个因子来看，九个发出做多信号，五个发出做空信号，一个中性，做多比例达到百分之六十。综合指标值为零点四五，整体偏向多头。复合指标胜率高达百分之七十一四点三，显示中期做多逻辑较为可靠。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪受到宏观面和链上基本面的双重影响。宏观方面，美国强劲的非农就业数据虽然压制了整体风险偏好，但以太坊表现出相对抗跌的特征。俄罗斯央行批准零售投资者交易以太坊，上限为三十万卢布，预计十一月中旬生效，这一消息为区域市场带来了新的增量资金预期。

链上数据显示，大额地址持续从交易所提币至私人钱包，鲸鱼现货累积行为明显，有效对冲了现货卖压。这种持续的链上提币行为通常被视为中长期看多信号，表明大户对后市仍抱有信心。

然而，风险因素同样不容忽视。以太坊现货ETF在十一月六日遭遇九千三百三十万美元的净流出，机构资金的持续撤离对价格构成压力。技术路线图方面，Glamsterdam升级测试网因Gas重新定价缺陷而暂停，给技术进展蒙上阴影。价格目前被压制在九十九日EMA的二千二百七十八美元下方，短期内需要突破该位置才能打开上行空间。

从ETH与BTC的比价关系来看，当前比值处于历史低位区间，若宏观环境改善或以太坊生态出现新的催化剂，ETH有望迎来补涨行情。短期关注二千二百二十八美元的布林带下轨支撑，若跌破则可能下探二千二百美元整数关口。

The stake, entry conditions, and settlement method are all the same for each trade, so you can tell which part is actually making money.

Watching how much others make will only make you enter too early.

When your hands start itching to trade, turning off the app is more effective than forcing self-control.
The longer you watch the market, the stronger the urge to place a trade becomes.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we'll look at how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates stay high and positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp drop caused by a long squeeze could happen at any moment. I'm not telling you to immediately
short, but rather: be especially cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out already has, yet people are still shorting. Many major historical rallies started at times like these.

亲爱的币安广场用户：
感谢大家一直以来对币安广场的支持与陪伴。
为营造真实、理性、友善的交流环境，币安广场近期更新了[《社区准则常见问题》](https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/support/faq/detail/ecb50ef2012f40b2a2c4f72eaa5b569f)，主要涉及返佣推广行为和社区交流秩序两方面，适用范围包括直播、帖子、评论、聊天室及个人主页等。具体如下：
一、返佣推广行为规范
根据返佣团队[《超级返佣成员拓展市场行为规范》](https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/learn/affiliate-rule)的明确要求，"严禁在币安广场内以任何形式引导老用户更换账户、重新注册或虚假宣传/承诺等行为"。为配合该规范落地，广场同步更新以下规则：
直播场景：直播画面及直播间装饰中，请勿展示返佣码、注册链接、助力人信息等推广性内容，以保障直播间的观看体验。
帖子及个人主页：请勿以返佣比例作为宣传卖点；请勿在个人简介中展示返佣码、注册链接或助力人信息，也请勿在个人主页置顶返佣相关帖子。
引导更换账户：在广场内任何场景中，严禁以任何形式诱导已注册用户注销、更换账户或重新注册，包括但不限于引导其使用亲属或他人身份信息注册新账户。

二、理性交流，拒绝人身攻击
我们欢迎不同观点之间的理性讨论，但不允许讨论演变为人身攻击和骚扰。以下行为将被视为违规：
侮辱攻击：基于外貌、职业、身份、健康状况等侮辱或贬低他人；攻击他人家人，或使用涉及亲属、性侮辱、人格贬损的内容攻击他人。
诅咒威胁：诅咒他人死亡、患病或遭受严重伤害，或威胁伤害他人。
针对性围攻：持续针对特定对象发布攻击性内容，或将冲突扩散至无关帖子、评论区、直播间或群聊；组织、号召他人集中辱骂、刷屏或围攻他人。
侵犯隐私：未经授权披露他人真实姓名、证件、住址、联系方式、财务信息等个人信息，或组织、参与人肉搜索。
以上行为即使使用截图、剪辑、暗语、谐音或影射等方式，平台也会结合上下文识别并处理。

三、整改安排
即日起至 11 月 20 日为整改期。请各位用户对照上述规范，对直播间画面、个人主页及过往发布的内容进行自查，如有涉及请及时调整或删除。
整改期结束后，相关规范将正式执行。对于未按时整改的内容，平台将统一重置个人简介、处理违规内容，并开展常态化巡查，依据[《币安广场社区准则常见问题》](https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/support/faq/detail/ecb50ef2012f40b2a2c4f72eaa5b569f)对违规行为实行递增处罚。
社区的美好需要每一个人共同守护。如对本次更新有任何疑问，欢迎联系币安客服。感谢大家的理解与配合！

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

【How it works】Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

以太坊市场深度分析：鲸鱼托底下的震荡蓄势

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月七日下午六时，以太坊现货价格报两千二百四十四美元，过去二十四小时小幅上涨百分之零点三八。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在近五个小时内维持窄幅整理，价格运行区间为两千二百四十二至两千二百五十一美元，波动幅度不足十美元，展现出较强的抗跌韧性。

成交量方面，最近四个完整小时的USDT计价成交额分别为四百五十三万、四百四十九万、三百四十万和七百四十万美元。第三个小时量能明显萎缩后，第四个小时出现放量回升，显示有资金在低位积极承接。价格稳于两千二百四十美元上方，短期底部支撑较为扎实。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格位于七小时均线两千两百四十七美元附近，与短期均线基本持平。二十五小时均线位于两千两百四十美元，为价格提供即时支撑。九十九小时均线位于两千两百九十九美元，远高于当前价格，构成中期上行压力。短期均线粘合、长期均线压制的格局与BTC类似，表明ETH同样处于方向选择的关键节点。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千两百五十五美元，中轨位于两千两百四十一美元，下轨位于两千两百二十八美元。价格在中轨和上轨之间运行，略偏强势。带宽约为二十七美元，处于收窄状态，同样暗示变盘临近。

MACD指标呈现持续改善态势。当前MACD线为负一点八四，信号线为负四点五一，柱状图为正二点六七。MACD线虽在零轴下方，但柱状图连续五个周期为正，空头动能持续衰减。与BTC相比，ETH的MACD修复节奏更为平稳，显示卖压相对温和。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报五十八点三九，略偏多头区域。十二周期RSI为五十二点三五，二十四周期RSI为四十五点三六。短期RSI高于五十，表明短线多头略占优势，但中长期RSI仍偏弱，整体格局偏中性。

KDJ指标中，K值为六十六点六二，D值为六十八点二二，J值为六十三点四一。三线处于中性偏上区域，未进入超买，仍有上行空间。

抛物线SAR报两千两百二十美元，远低于当前价格，看涨信号明确。超级趋势线位于两千二百七十三美元，高于当前价格，构成上方阻力。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与BTC有相似之处，但也有其独特因素。宏观层面，美国超预期非农数据同样对ETH构成压力，美联储加息预期升温压缩了风险资产的流动性空间。

资金面上，以太坊现货ETF过去七天累计流出约十七万四千六百八十七枚ETH，十一月六日单日净流出九千三百三十万美元。机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成结构性压制。

然而，ETH的链上基本面呈现积极变化。大型钱包近期增持超过两万一千七百枚ETH，同时有约九十八万七千枚ETH处于质押排队状态。大量ETH被锁定在质押和网络中，有效减少了流通供给，为价格提供了坚实的底部支撑。

政策面方面，俄罗斯宣布将于十一月十七日开放ETH零售交易，为市场带来增量需求预期。不过，Glamsterdam硬分叉和Hoodi测试网因Gas重新定价问题暂停，给网络升级前景蒙上不确定性。

综合来看，ETH在两千两百二十八至两千两百五十五美元的布林带区间内蓄势，多空力量趋于均衡。突破方向将取决于宏观数据后续走向和机构资金流向的变化。相较于BTC，ETH的多头因子占比更高，达到百分之六十六点七，技术面略偏乐观。

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant; it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position to reduce risk instead of closing it all at once.

Ethereum Institutional Report Update | On-chain Usage Grows but Fees Fall | ETH Buying Demand Still Needs Confirmation

My stance is neutral to cautious. The improving data is worth watching, but network usage cannot be directly translated into ETH gains. Binance Square’s Most Searched list over the past six hours named ETH a Rapid Riser; I went back to check the original figures in Ethereum Institutional’s November 5 report, “State of the Ledger.” The report cites Token Terminal data: from January through October 2026, the Ethereum mainnet averaged about 2.17 million transactions per day, up 54% year over year. Over the same period, the daily median mainnet transaction fee averaged about 3.5 cents, compared with about 35 cents on a comparable basis last year. The nominal total value of mainnet stablecoin transfers was about $25.8 trillion, up 61% year over year. These are statistics covering ten months—not $25.8 trillion that suddenly flowed in today, nor $25.8 trillion all spent buying ETH.

What matters more to me is the combination of “growing usage and lower fees per transaction.” More transfers suggest demand for the settlement network, while lower fees benefit payments and applications. But lower fees also mean we cannot infer from transaction counts alone that fee revenue or token burns will rise in tandem. The report itself cautions that transfer counts do not equal unique users, stablecoin transfer volume includes unfiltered activity such as internal transfers, and neither necessarily represents real payments or institutional settlement. For ETH’s price, we also need to keep watching actual gas spending, staking and unstaking, fund flows, and sentiment toward risk assets. Equating network activity with an immediate contraction in supply is a leap I would not make.

Macro conditions and institutional flows have not offered confirmation in the same direction either. On October 28, the Federal Reserve kept its target rate range at 3.75% to 4%. Farside data shows an estimated net outflow of about $93.3 million from U.S. ETH funds overall on November 6. This figure is an estimate of fund subscriptions and redemptions for that trading day; it does not mean that an equal amount of spot ETH is being sold every minute right now. The sampled Kraken ETH/USD price is about $2,243.57, with a 24-hour low of $2,201.26 and high of $2,250.60, still within the range. My key levels are support near $2,200 and the $2,251 upper boundary: a break below $2,200 without a recovery would invalidate the bullish bias; even a move above $2,251 needs to be followed by a successful retest and volume confirmation. I would not chase the price just because search interest is rising.

If I were trading myself, I would sit out for now, with a neutral directional view and no position. I would consider an unleveraged spot purchase only if ETH holds above $2,251 and successfully retests it, while fund outflows ease or there is sustained evidence of improving on-chain fees. The position would be capped at 0.35% of total capital. The first target is $2,310; I would take half off there and hold the rest toward $2,380. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,195. If $2,200 breaks first, I will continue to wait rather than buy the dip based on a single statistic. These are conditional plans only; no trade has been placed.

Sources: Ethereum Institutional’s November 5 “State of the Ledger” and its Token Terminal figures; the Federal Reserve’s October 28 statement; Farside ETH fund flow table; Kraken ETH/USD market data. #ETH

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与BTC有相似之处，但也有其独特因素。宏观层面，美国超预期非农数据同样对ETH构成压力，美联储加息预期升温压缩了风险资产的流动性空间。

资金面上，以太坊现货ETF过去七天累计流出约十七万四千六百八十七枚ETH，十一月六日单日净流出九千三百三十万美元。机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成结构性压制。

然而，ETH的链上基本面呈现积极变化。大型钱包近期增持超过两万一千七百枚ETH，同时有约九十八万七千枚ETH处于质押排队状态。大量ETH被锁定在质押和网络中，有效减少了流通供给，为价格提供了坚实的底部支撑。

政策面方面，俄罗斯宣布将于十一月十七日开放ETH零售交易，为市场带来增量需求预期。不过，Glamsterdam硬分叉和Hoodi测试网因Gas重新定价问题暂停，给网络升级前景蒙上不确定性。

综合来看，ETH在两千两百二十八至两千两百五十五美元的布林带区间内蓄势，多空力量趋于均衡。突破方向将取决于宏观数据后续走向和机构资金流向的变化。相较于BTC，ETH的多头因子占比更高，达到百分之六十六点七，技术面略偏乐观。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

When opening a futures contract, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

[Cross margin] All the funds in your account are used as margin. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all back each other up in the same basket.

[Isolated margin] Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

Bloomberg and security firm Blockaid reviewed the on-chain Ethereum transactions: At around 20:20 UTC on October 29 (04:20 on October 30 in UTC+8), the attacker first paid about $15 in network fees to grant proxy permissions to Binance’s hot wallet “Binance 14.” This transaction itself did not move any coins; it merely authorized external code to act on the wallet’s behalf. About three and a half minutes later, a sweep transaction using the same permissions transferred approximately $2.5 billion, around 40% of the total stolen at the time. This included about 167,000 ETH, USDT worth approximately $1.6 billion, and more than 60 other tokens.

Binance disclosed that the attack was a multistage operation in which engineers were tricked by fake job offers into downloading malware. The authorization was recorded on-chain, so disabling withdrawals or deactivating the hot wallet could not automatically revoke it. Blockchain intelligence firm Elliptic said that approximately $3.6 billion was later transferred using the same permissions. A Binance spokesperson confirmed that EIP-7702 played a significant role in the attack, and said the company had revoked the affected delegations, rebuilt its wallet infrastructure, and strengthened signing and monitoring. User funds remain safe, and Binance is absorbing the financial losses itself. At around 18:55 on November 7 (UTC+8), Binance spot prices were approximately $2,245 for $ETH, $89.9 for $SOL, and $694 for BNB.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT in principal and use 10x leverage, you actually control a position worth
1,000 USDT. If the coin price rises 1%, your principal earns 10% (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact point also depends on the margin ratio).

Your Ethereum transaction fee does not all go to the validator.

On Ethereum Mainnet, the base fee is burned: that ETH is removed from circulation. The priority fee, or tip, goes to the validator. Both contribute to what you pay for execution.

Why care? A higher total fee does not mean the validator receives the entire increase. For the same amount of computation, a rising base fee can make a transaction more expensive without increasing its tip.

Before confirming, inspect the fee estimate and whether the action can wait. The risk: choosing a lower fee can delay inclusion, and waiting does not guarantee cheaper execution.

Source: Ethereum.org — https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/gas/

title: Cryptocurrency: The Future of Digital Finance, New Investment Horizons & Opportunities
subTitle:
The world is rapidly moving towards a digital economy. One of the most talked-about developments in this transformation is Cryptocurrency. Starting with Bitcoin, this technology has created new opportunities in global investment, economics, and financial technology.

Cryptocurrency is not just a way to make money; it is an attempt to reshape the future financial system through Blockchain technology.

1. Bitcoin: The King of the Crypto World

Bitcoin was introduced in 2009 by the mysterious creator known as Satoshi Nakamoto. Today, it remains the world's most recognized and influential cryptocurrency.

One of Bitcoin's most important features is its maximum supply of 21 million coins. Due to this limited supply, many investors consider Bitcoin to be Digital Gold.

In the long term, Bitcoin's global adoption, institutional investment, and increasing demand may play important roles in determining its future value.

2. Altcoins: New Technology and Investment Opportunities
Beyond Bitcoin, the cryptocurrency market contains thousands of alternative cryptocurrencies, commonly known as Altcoins.

Some notable examples include:
Ethereum $ETH : Smart Contracts and Decentralized Applications.Solana $SOL : High-speed Blockchain Transactions.$BNB : The Binance Ecosystem.XRP: International Payment Solutions.Chainlink (LINK): Connecting Blockchain with Real-World Data.

Other projects, including Harmony (ONE), Fetch.ai (FET), and several emerging cryptocurrencies, are also attempting to establish their positions through innovative technologies.

However, it is essential to independently evaluate each cryptocurrency's technology, real-world utility, security, and long-term potential before investing.

3. 2026–2029: The Future of the Cryptocurrency Market

Over the next few years, several important factors may influence the cryptocurrency market:

Institutional Adoption: Increased participation from major financial institutions.
Bitcoin Halving: A reduction in the rate of new Bitcoin supply.Artificial Intelligence: The integration of AI and Blockchain technologies.Real-World Assets (RWA): Tokenization of real-world assets.Global Regulation: Cryptocurrency policies and regulations across different countries.

These developments could significantly influence the future of the cryptocurrency industry. However, market movements can never be predicted with certainty.

4. Important Things to Know Before Investing in Crypto

Cryptocurrency offers opportunities for substantial returns, but it also carries significant financial risks.

To become a responsible investor, consider following these principles:

Invest according to your financial capacity.Avoid investing all your money at once.Follow a long-term investment strategy.Conduct Fundamental Analysis of every project.Be cautious with excessive leverage and Futures Trading.Avoid fraudulent coins and fake investment schemes.Store your cryptocurrencies in secure wallets.

5. Conclusion: The Future Belongs to Those Who Move Forward with Knowledge

Cryptocurrency has the potential to play an important role in the future global economy.

However, investing simply because others are doing so or because of the hope of making quick profits is not a wise decision.

Remember, the most important factors in cryptocurrency investing are patience, knowledge, research, and effective Risk Management.

There will always be opportunities in the market, but taking advantage of those opportunities requires informed decisions.

"Don't invest because of hype. Invest because you understand the technology, the value and the risk."

— The Future of Digital Finance

Ethereum Geth RPC hang fix awaits review｜Developer-call reliability and mainnet security are separate issues｜Stay disciplined near $2,220

My stance remains cautious. In the official repository for Ethereum’s execution client Geth, PR #36076  proposes addressing a race condition that can cause some RPC calls to hang. It is currently open, has not been merged, and has no deployment record. The author describes a scenario where a read failure occurs while a request is being sent; if the write has already succeeded but the corresponding state update has not completed, calls without a timeout may wait indefinitely for a completion signal. The submitter provided a test that reliably reproduces this sequence and reported that, in local tests under the same load, the old code hung 19 times out of 20,715 runs, while the modified code did not hang in 23,143 runs. This is only the submitter’s test result and does not represent the network-wide incident rate. The original issue, #30591 , documents the background of the test instability. I will not misrepresent a hang at the developer-tools layer as an Ethereum mainnet outage, on-chain fund loss, or a smart contract failure.

The market relevance of this kind of change is infrastructure experience: wallets, data services, and application backends use RPC to query or send requests. If a faulty connection can return an error promptly, higher-level services can more easily retry or switch nodes, reducing the time users spend facing an unresponsive interface. But the fix is still awaiting review, and there is a long way to go before it enters a release and is actually adopted by operators. It also will not directly increase ETH staking yields, change transaction fees, or bring in new institutional buyers. The Ethereum Foundation has also recently been discussing Gas repricing compatibility issues for Glamsterdam, but that is a separate testing and upgrade effort and should not be conflated with this Geth RPC proposal.

The market price has not shown an increase attributable to this proposal: at the time of observation, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,223.37, below the day’s open of $2,235.40; the intraday low was around $2,220.01 and the high $2,249.20. Farside’s data for Nov 6 showed net outflows of around $93.3 million from U.S. ETH funds in total. That is fund-flow data for the previous trading day’s products, not an indication of every spot sell order at this moment over the weekend. Around $2,220 is short-term support, while around $2,249 is the first resistance a rebound would need to clear. If the price breaks below $2,220 and fails to reclaim it, I will abandon my short-term bullish view. If it moves back above $2,249 and holds on a retest, I will also need to see whether trading volume and BTC stabilize at the same time.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now, and consider only a conditional spot long, with a 0% position. I would place a test trade using 0.4% of total capital only if ETH closes two consecutive 15-minute candles above $2,250 and then holds $2,245–$2,250 on a retest. I would take half off at the first target of $2,275, then reduce half of the remaining position at the second target of $2,305. The hard stop would be set at $2,218. After entry, I would close the remaining position early if two consecutive 15-minute candles fall back below $2,245, or if a primary source discloses a new client compatibility risk. If the price breaks below $2,220 first, this long plan is void. I would not average down against the trend or use leverage.

I will follow up on the PR review, the official release, and adoption by node service providers. The technical proposal is a fact; improved user experience and any repricing remain to be verified. Weekend liquidity is limited, making it all the more important to define position size and stops before trading.

以太坊Geth修复RPC卡住问题待审｜开发者调用稳定性与主网安全要分开｜2220美元附近守纪律

我的态度仍是谨慎。以太坊执行客户端 Geth 的官方仓库里，PR #36076 提议处理一类 RPC 调用卡住的竞态问题，目前 Open、尚未合并，也没有部署记录。作者描述：当连接在发送请求期间发生读取失败，若写入已经成功而相关状态更新尚未完成，缺少超时设置的调用可能一直等不到结束信号。提交者给出可稳定复现该顺序的测试，并报告在本地同负载测试里，旧代码运行20,715次出现19次卡住，改动后23,143次中未出现；这只是提交者的测试结果，不代表全网事故率。原问题 #30591 记录的是测试不稳定的背景。我不会把开发工具层面的卡住，误写成以太坊主网停摆、链上资金丢失或智能合约已经出错。

这类改动与市场的关联在于基础设施体验：钱包、数据服务和应用后端会通过 RPC 查询或发送请求。若异常连接能及时返回错误，上层服务更容易重试或切换节点，减少用户面对无响应界面的时间。但修复尚待审阅，进入版本和运营方实际更新仍有距离；它也不会直接增加 ETH 质押收益、改变手续费或带来新机构买盘。最近以太坊基金会还在讨论 Glamsterdam 的 Gas 重定价兼容问题，但那是另一项测试和升级工作，不能和本次 Geth RPC 提案合并描述。

威廉指标WR显示为负87.43，已经进入超卖区域。随机RSI指标为6.40，同样处于极度超卖状态。值得注意的是，以太坊的综合技术指标信号为做多，胜率高达79.17%，这表明从历史统计来看，当前技术形态下的反弹概率较高。

技术面的超卖状态为反弹提供了条件，但基本面的挑战不容忽视。Glamsterdam升级的延期不仅影响了市场对以太坊技术执行力的信心，也可能推迟一些依赖该升级的DeFi协议和创新应用。投资者需要密切关注升级进展和ETF资金流向的变化。如果价格能够守住2220美元的关键支撑，结合当前的超卖指标，短期内出现技术性反弹的可能性较大。

Over the past six days, the address has withdrawn a total of 13,077.46 ETH at an average price of about $2,290, with an unrealized loss of roughly $681,000 at the time. It had ranged from about $2,225 to $2,254, keeping it almost right at the day's low. By a rough calculation at that price, the whale's unrealized loss had grown to just over $800,000—a clear sign of buying more as the price falls. Its average purchase price is about 2.8% above the current price; in other words, ETH would need to rise back to around $2,290 for the position to break even.

At the same time, $BTC  was trading at about $75,625, down 0.29%; SOL was around $88.97, down 1%; and BNB was about $694.95, up a slight 0.28%, making it one of the few major coins in the green.

Hong Kong SFC plans to tighten use of terms like “crypto exchange”｜Legislation still pending, not a crypto ban｜ETH at $2,232; I’ll wait

My stance is cautiously neutral. The trending topic #HKSFCPlansToRestrictCryptoAndExchangeTerms on Binance Square discusses Hong Kong’s virtual asset regulation, and it’s worth clarifying the facts. On November 6, the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) announced the conclusions of its consultation on restrictions on misleading names, along with frequently asked questions. It plans to extend existing restrictions under the Securities and Futures Ordinance and add corresponding rules under the Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance, targeting names that could mislead the public into thinking a platform is regulated or affiliated with a well-known exchange. Examples cited by the authorities include terms such as “crypto exchange” and “digital currency trading platform.” The proposal concerns whether a platform’s name matches its authorization; it is not a ban on ETH trading, nor has it declared all names containing “crypto” illegal with immediate effect.

The timing gap is important. The SFC’s FAQ states that it still needs to finalize the amended text with the Hong Kong government and submit it to the Legislative Council for consideration. The proposed rules would take effect six months after the legislation is passed. This is now a consultation conclusion, not a new law already in force, and it certainly does not mean that any particular exchange is being shut down today. Licensed platforms, prospective license applicants, and service providers targeting Hong Kong customers will each need to assess their names, business activities, and authorization scope. Users should also verify a platform’s actual license rather than judge its safety by its branding. If the rules are ultimately implemented, compliance costs for market entry could rise and room for misleading promotion could shrink. Any medium- to long-term impact on ETH would be transmitted gradually through available trading channels, custody, and institutional participation—not by a consultation conclusion directly creating on-chain demand.

The market reaction remains fairly subdued. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,232.05, below the daily open of $2,235.40. The intraday low was $2,227.15 and the high was $2,249.20; there has been no obvious rally in response to this Hong Kong proposal. Farside data show net outflows of about $93.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 6, and the flow backdrop also does not support automatically interpreting regulatory discussion as buying pressure. Binance Square’s search rankings may label ETH a Rapid Riser, but rising searches indicate attention, not a confirmed trend. I’m watching $2,227 as near-term support, with $2,250 as the intraday ceiling. If ETH breaks below $2,227 and fails to recover it, I should abandon my mildly bullish view. U.S. employment data and the upcoming CPI release could both affect risk assets, so not every candlestick can be attributed to Hong Kong policy.

If I were trading this myself: my current ETH position is 0%, and I would only consider a leveraged-free spot entry. I would enter with no more than 0.4% of my total capital only if two complete 15-minute candles close above $2,251 and a retest holds the $2,246–$2,251 range. I’d first take half off at $2,270, then close the remainder at $2,290. After entering, if a 15-minute candle closes below $2,238, I’d reduce the position by half; at $2,222, I’d stop out and close the entire position. If ETH breaks below $2,227 before entry, the plan is canceled. If the legislative text differs from expectations set by the FAQ, fund outflows increase, or overall market risk appetite deteriorates significantly, I’ll reassess. I’d rather miss out than chase prices based on rumors.

香港证监会拟收紧“加密交易所”等名称｜仍待立法不是禁币｜ETH在2232美元我先等

我的态度是审慎中性。币安广场上升话题#HKSFCPlansToRestrictCryptoAndExchangeTerms讨论香港虚拟资产监管，值得把事实边界说清。香港证监会11月6日公布误导性名称限制的咨询结论及常见问题：拟扩展现有《证券及期货条例》相关限制，并在反洗钱条例下增加对应规则，针对可能让公众误认平台已获监管或与知名交易所有关联的名称。官方举的例子包括“crypto exchange”和“digital currency trading platform”等组合。它指向平台名称与授权的匹配，不是ETH交易禁令，也没有宣布所有含“crypto”的名称即时违法。

关键时间差不能跳过。证监会FAQ写明，仍要与香港政府完成修订文本、提交立法会审议；拟议安排是在法例通过后再延六个月生效。现在是咨询结论，不是新法已经执行，更不能推导为某家交易所今天被关停。已获牌照、拟申请牌照及面向香港客户的服务商会分别评估名称、业务性质和授权范围，用户也应核查平台真实牌照，而非凭招牌判断安全。若规则最终落实，市场入口的合规成本可能上升，误导性宣传空间可能缩小；对ETH的中长期影响要通过可用交易渠道、托管与机构参与逐步传导，不会由一个咨询结论直接制造链上需求。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (gas per unit).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring gas fees. That’s why seasoned users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operations can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Why is USDT pegged to $1? How stablecoins work
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade crypto futures without USDT, but many people haven’t wondered why it’s worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while putting
dollars (and equivalent assets) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars goes to the issuer
to redeem it. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to 0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly bring it back in line.

新手最大的误区：不持仓就等于没在交易。于是天天满仓进进出出，
手续费和波动把本金磨没了。

实际上，空仓是唯一一种「亏损为零」的仓位。看不懂的行情空仓，
多空打架的行情空仓，刚连错几笔之后空仓——这三个时刻省下来的钱，
比大部分交易赚的都多。

打猎的比喻都听腻了，但道理是真的：猎人大部分时间在等，扣扳机
只要一秒。手里有本金，机会来了你才有子弹。拿稳你的子弹。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is Also a Position—and the One Experts Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
A beginner’s biggest misconception: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility wear away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat,
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, staying flat after a few consecutive bad trades—the money you save at these three moments
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. If you have capital on hand, you’ll have bullets when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your bullets.

Late night · A breakdown of BTC’s movement over nearly 2 hours

Current price: 75,800.03u, 24h: -0.36%, intraday high/low: 75,695.89 / 75,891.52.
The lows are edging higher, but the highs haven’t made new highs to match. The contracting triangle hasn’t played out yet.

What matters about this candle is “who stepped in to buy at this level.” A long upper wick means selling pressure remains above; a long lower wick means buyers are stepping in below.
Reading candlesticks isn’t about whether a pattern looks good. It’s about where the price gets pushed back.

How I use it: I don’t try to guess tops or bottoms here. I only follow when the price breaks out of the range, and leave the rest to the expiry time.

Event contracts trade on “which direction the price will be at expiry”—not on guessing tops or bottoms. With a 30-minute expiry, if the direction is wrong, I accept it.

Account figures can lie; the curve can’t.
Short-term volatility can come down to luck. A consistent curve over dozens of days can only come from rules.

I’m not seeking certainty on a single trade. I’m aiming for positive expected value over a hundred trades.
Wins and losses on individual trades are normal. What matters is being profitable on average.

The data itself has no opinion; the interpretation does.
The same gain can mean completely different things depending on where it happens.

I don’t just post on good days—I post every day.
If someone only posts on good days, what you’re seeing is a curated result.

我怎么用：不在这里猜顶底，只在价格离开区间的那一刻跟一下，剩下的交给到期时间。

事件合约交易的是「到期那一刻的方向」，不是猜顶底。30 分钟到期，方向错了就认。

账户数字会骗人，曲线不会。
短期波动可以靠运气，几十天的连续曲线只能靠规则。

我不追求单笔的确定性，我追求一百笔之后的正期望。
单笔赢亏都正常，平均下来是正的才有意义。

数据本身没有观点，解读才有。
同样一个涨幅，放在不同位置，含义完全不同。

我不挑好看的日子发，每天照发。
只发好日子的人，你看到的是筛选后的结果。

📰 New U.S. regulations suddenly hit? ETH rallies against the trend—there's more than meets the eye

Russia recently formalized its cryptocurrency trading rules, which are set to take effect on November 17. This is good news for retail investors, who will be able to buy and sell BTC, ETH, and USDT through official channels. The Moscow Exchange also plans to launch cryptocurrency trading in December. In short, Russia is loosening restrictions on the crypto market and preparing to let ordinary people get involved. This could have a ripple effect across the European crypto market.

Why does this news matter?
Russia's move is driven by several factors. On the one hand, crypto regulation is becoming more accommodating worldwide, with the U.S. and Europe exploring how to legalize cryptocurrencies without losing control of them. Russia may have seen other places taking action and decided it can't afford to be left behind. On the other hand, Bitcoin and Ethereum have become widely recognized digital assets around the world. Russia's decision to allow trading signals official recognition of their value, which could boost market confidence. This is especially important for ETH, as it is one of the cryptocurrencies most commonly held by institutions.

The impact on the market could be immediate and multifaceted. In the short term, Russia's decision may lift sentiment in the crypto market, especially for ETH, which enjoys the broadest global acceptance. In the long term, if Russia succeeds in building a compliant crypto market, it could attract more international capital. Similar events in the past, such as El Salvador making Bitcoin legal tender, initially helped boost market sentiment. Russia's situation is more complicated, however, because of the uncertainty surrounding the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

Trading outlook
ETH could see a short-term sentiment-driven rebound in response to the news from Russia, but watch whether this can translate into momentum for a mid-term rally. If it holds above $2,200 over the next 24 hours, that could be seen as a positive signal. If it falls below that level, it would suggest that short-term sentiment is not providing enough upward momentum.

📰 美国监管新规突然杀到？ETH反而逆势拉升，背后暗藏玄机

俄罗斯最近正式了加密货币交易规则，打算在11月17号开始执行。这对零售投资者来说是个好消息，他们可以透过正规渠道买卖BTC、ETH和USDT了。莫斯科交易所也计划在12月推出加密货币交易。简单说，这是俄罗斯给加密市场松绑，准备让老百姓也能玩了，这对整个欧洲加密市场都可能有带动效应。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次俄罗斯动作背后是多重因素。一方面，全球范围内加密监管趋于温和，从美国到欧洲都在探索怎么让加密货币合法化又不完全失控。俄罗斯这次可能也是看到别的地方在搞，自己不跟上会被落下。另一方面，比特币和以太坊在全球范围内已经是共识性的数字资产，俄罗斯允许交易意味着官方承认了它们的价值，这会提升市场信心。对ETH尤其重要，因为ETH是机构配置最多的加密货币之一。

对市场的影响是直接和多层次的。短期看，俄罗斯这个决定可能会让加密货币市场情绪升温，尤其是ETH，因为它在全球的接受度最高。长期看，如果俄罗斯能成功建立起合规的加密市场，可能会吸引更多国际资本流入。历史上类似事件，比如萨尔瓦多发行比特币法币，初期就有提振市场情绪的效果。不过俄罗斯的情况更复杂，因为它还有乌俄冲突带来的不确定性。

操作思路
ETH可能因为俄罗斯这个新闻产生短期情绪反弹，但要注意这是否能转化为中期上涨动力。如果能在接下来的24小时内守住$2,200这个价位，可以视为积极信号。如果跌破这个位置，说明短期情绪驱动的上涨动力不足。

Just as expectations of a Fed rate hike were said to be shifting, the crypto market barely reacted. Now Bitcoin has a chance of reaching $70,000.
Crypto prediction tools now put the odds of BTC breaking $70,000 by 2027 at 52%, even as prices have recently pulled back.

We just talked about this a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. Prediction markets have taken a guess at Bitcoin’s future: there’s a 52% chance it will reach the $70,000 mark by the end of 2027. More aggressive bettors think there’s a 24% chance it could hit $90,000, and a 9% chance it could reach $100,000. These estimates are based on data from Polymarket and Kalshi, which act like polling machines for the crypto world. But as for the market’s actual temperature, Bitcoin is currently at just $75,827, down 6.6% over the past month, suggesting sentiment is somewhat divided. In particular, Kalshi futures show the market is more focused on whether BTC will trade in the $70,000–$75,000 range at the end of this year.

Market impact
- Short term: These predictions don’t directly push prices higher, but they reflect a degree of optimism that could give the market a little more confidence to bet on a rise. There’s no obvious change in capital flows for now, but if more institutions follow these probability forecasts, they could attract some speculative money.
- Medium term: If Bitcoin can climb above $70,000 next year or the year after, that would show the crypto market has successfully put macroeconomic risks—such as Fed rate hikes—behind it, further cementing the industry’s standing. For now, Bitcoin’s long-term potential is still viewed favorably, but short-term prices will depend on actual inflows and the moves of whales.

My take
I think the 52% probability is a bit overestimated, but it does reflect the market’s confidence in BTC’s long-term resilience. Short-term support is around $70K–$72K; if it holds there, the $70,000 target won’t be far off. But honestly, market sentiment right now feels like it’s saying, “Yeah, right.” Predictions and reality often move in opposite directions. I’m 70% confident in this assessment; I’ll leave the other 30% up to the market. Which side are you on? 🎯

刚说美联储加息预期要变，加密市场不感冒，现在比特币概率要冲7万美元了
加密市场预测工具现在认为BTC有52%概率到2027年突破7万美元，但价格最近在回落。

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。 prediction markets（预测市场）给比特币算了一卦：52%的概率在2027年底前能摸到7万美元大关。更激进的赌徒觉得有24%可能到9万美元，9%能冲到10万美元。这些算盘是基于Polymarket和Kalshi的数据，像是加密圈的民意调查机。不过要说实际温度，比特币现在才$75,827，过去一个月还跌了6.6%，显示出市场情绪有点分裂。特别是Kalshi的期货显示，市场更关注今年年底BTC会不会在7万到7.5万美元区间震荡。

对市场的影响
- 短期：这些预测本身不直接推高价格，但它们反映了某种乐观预期，可能给市场注入一点赌涨的勇气。资金流向暂时看不出大变化，但如果有更多机构跟进这种概率预测，可能会吸引一些投机资金。
- 中期：如果比特币真能在明年或后年站上7万美元，那会证明加密市场已经成功把宏观经济风险（比如美联储加息）甩到身后，行业地位会进一步巩固。现在看，比特币的长期潜力依然被看好，但短期价格还是要看实际资金流入和鲸鱼们的动向。

我的判断
我觉得这个52%的概率是有点被高估了，但确实反映了市场对BTC长期韧性的信心。短期支撑在$70-72K附近，如果站稳这个位置，7万美元的目标就不遥远。不过说实话，现在市场情绪像是在说“我信你个鬼”，预测和现实经常反着来，这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场。这波你站哪边？🎯

ETH remains at $2,233 | Fund outflows coincide with Glamsterdam testing delay | Focus on risk management first

My stance is to wait and see, and not interpret an adjustment to the development timeline as a mainnet failure. On November 6, the Ethereum Foundation published a research update on Glamsterdam: during testnet checks, the security team found that some contracts rely on outdated gas-cost assumptions. The state gas and operation repricing in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 could change the gas remaining after a failed call, allowing failure-handling paths that would previously have reverted to continue executing. Core developers have therefore decided to further delay the Hoodi testnet hard fork and revisit the schedule once the issue is resolved. The Foundation's earlier announcement on October 22 also made clear that no new activation date has been set. This is an investigation into compatibility with a future upgrade—not evidence that funds have been lost on Ethereum mainnet today, and certainly not a sign that Glamsterdam has already launched.

Why should traders care? Whether contracts can safely handle gas edge cases directly affects application stability during future upgrades. Delaying testing proactively can reduce the tail risk of a rushed deployment, but it also lengthens the market's wait for the benefits of scaling. A technical analysis by security auditor ChainSecurity notes that the behavior of some low-gas failure paths may differ from before. This shows that the investigation is based on a real technical concern, but it does not justify claiming that all DeFi contracts have vulnerabilities. Development teams still need to identify affected projects, revise specifications or contracts, and then announce a new testnet schedule. My criteria are verifiable fixes, tests, and activation plans from official sources—not dates guessed on social media.

Fund flows offer no immediate evidence to support the technical story as a reason for prices to rise. Farside's figures show net outflows of about $93.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 6, including about $90.8 million from ETHA. These are changes in fund share flows; they should not be mechanically equated with every dollar being sold simultaneously on the spot order book. ETH appeared as a Rapid Riser in a six-hour search on Binance Square, but rising attention does not necessarily mean rising buying pressure. When I checked Kraken ETH/USD, the latest price was about $2,232.83, below the daily open of $2,235.40. The day's low was $2,227.15 and high was $2,249.20, with a 24-hour low of $2,222.56. The market remains in a low range, with no clear breakout driven by upgrade news so far.

My key levels are around $2,222 and $2,250. If the price breaks below $2,222 and fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my short-term support thesis is invalidated. If it can move above $2,250 and hold on a retest, then there would be reason to look toward higher resistance. If fund outflows continue to grow, or official disclosures show that the compatibility issue is broader than currently understood, I would also proactively reduce my risk budget. Conversely, even if the development team resolves the issue, I would not predict an immediate ETH price rise based on a single announcement; trading volume, spreads, and actual price support still need to be verified.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long after confirmation, with a position size of 0%. Only if ETH moves above $2,250, retests $2,245 and holds, and spreads remain stable across major venues would I open a trial position using 0.4% of total capital, without leverage. The first target is $2,275, where I would cut the position by half; I would target $2,300 for the remainder and exit in stages if it gets there. I would set a stop-loss at $2,238. A decisive break below $2,222 would mean closing the entire position and scrapping the follow-up plan. If the upgrade schedule remains unclear or ETF funding pressure increases, I would rather hold cash and wait. If the conditions are not met, there is no trade or profit to review.

ETH仍在2233美元｜基金流出与Glamsterdam测试延期并行｜先看风险修复

我的态度是观望，不把一次开发进度调整解释成主网故障。以太坊基金会11月6日发布关于Glamsterdam的研究说明：在测试网检查中，安全团队发现部分合约依赖旧的Gas计费假设，EIP-8037与EIP-8038的状态Gas及操作重新定价可能改变失败调用后的剩余Gas，使原本会回滚的失败处理路径继续完成。核心开发者因此决定继续推迟Hoodi测试网硬分叉，待问题解决后再定进程；基金会先前10月22日公告也明确，新激活日期尚未确定。这是对未来升级兼容性的排查，不是今天以太坊主网已经发生资金损失，更不能写成Glamsterdam已经上线。

这件事为何值得交易者关心？合约是否能安全应对Gas边界，直接影响未来升级时应用的稳定性；主动延后测试可减少仓促部署的尾部风险，但也会拉长市场等待扩容效益的时间。安全审计方ChainSecurity的技术分析指出，部分低Gas失败路径的行为可能变得与过去不同；这说明排查有真实技术依据，却不能据此声称所有DeFi合约都有漏洞。开发团队仍需统计受影响项目、修订规范或合约，再公布新的测试网时间。我的判断条件是官方给出可核验的修复、测试与激活安排，而不是社交媒体自行猜测日期。

资金面没有替技术故事提供立即上涨的证据。Farside汇总的11月6日美国现货ETH基金净流出约9330万美元，其中ETHA流出约9080万美元；这是基金份额资金变化，不能机械等同每一笔都在现货盘口同时卖出。币安广场六小时搜索里ETH显示Rapid Riser，但关注上升也不等于买盘上升。我查看Kraken ETH/USD时，末价约2232.83美元，低于日开2235.40；当日低点2227.15、高点2249.20，24小时低点2222.56。市场仍在低位区间，尚无明确的升级消息驱动突破。

我的关键位是2222美元一带和2250美元一带。若跌破2222且反抽收不回，短线支撑判断失效；若能站上2250并回踩守住，才有理由看向更高阻力。若基金流出持续扩大、或官方披露兼容问题范围超出目前了解，也要主动降低风险预算。相反，即使开发团队解决问题，也不能只凭一份公告就预判ETH立刻涨价，仍要验证交易量、价差和实际价格承接。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅考虑确认后的现货小仓多头，仓位0%。只有ETH站上2250美元、回踩2245仍守住且主要场所价差稳定，我才用总资金0.4%试仓，不用杠杆。第一目标2275美元，到位减仓一半；余仓看2300，触及后分批平仓。止损设在2238美元，有效跌破2222美元则全部平仓并撤销后续计划。若升级排期继续不明或ETF资金压力扩大，我宁可留现金等待。条件未触发，就没有成交和收益可复盘。
