📰 Elliptic: Binance Hackers Convert $124 Million into BTC; $2.85 Billion in Stolen Funds Remains Frozen—Why Is Recovery So Difficult This Time?

A new report from cryptocurrency security firm Elliptic shows that tokens worth $124 million stolen in last year’s Binance hack have been converted into Bitcoin, but the huge sum does not appear to have been cashed out into fiat currency yet. More concerning, the remaining $2.85 billion in crypto assets still cannot be moved. The incident once again highlights the enormous challenges of recovering blockchain assets.

Why does this news matter?
Elliptic’s tracking shows that the hackers have been gradually dispersing the stolen funds across multiple wallets through anonymous transactions on darknet markets. Notably, most of the stolen assets are still circulating within the crypto ecosystem, suggesting that the hackers are waiting for a more favorable time to cash out or looking for more discreet ways to convert the funds. This reflects two persistent pain points in the industry:
1. Blockchain recovery mechanisms are inefficient, with a lack of effective cross-platform tracing tools.
2. Compliance gaps remain in crypto cash-out channels, while regulators struggle to coordinate oversight of darknet trading platforms.
This phenomenon of “stolen assets neither disappearing nor going away” resembles the movement of funds following the 2020 Coinbase hack, suggesting that the security systems of major exchanges still have vulnerabilities that can be exploited.

Market impact
In terms of market sentiment, news like this could heighten investors’ concerns about exchange security. Although BTC and ETH have been relatively unaffected in the short term (currently trading at $75.87K and $2.238K, respectively), if regulatory measures fail to improve recovery rates, regulators may introduce stricter anti-money-laundering rules over the longer term. As for fund flows, demand to cash out smaller-cap coins may increase, but there has been no significant overall outflow of funds.

Trading outlook
💡 For now, the short-term sentiment impact on ETH ($2.238K) appears greater, as the BTC ($75.87K) used by the hackers is more valuable, but event-driven selling pressure across the broader market remains limited. A chain reaction would only be triggered if an exchange were forced to suspend withdrawals because of a similar incident in the future.

Elliptic的追踪显示，黑客通过在暗网市场匿名交易，将赃款缓慢分散到多个钱包。值得注意的是，这些被盗资产大部分仍停留在加密世界内部流转，说明黑客在等待更有利的套现时机或正在寻找更隐蔽的变现方式。这背后反映了两个行业痛点：

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover: your losses
The same types of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five rules—not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it’s that their execution breaks down. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: EL SÍNDROME DE BARTLEBY: POR QUÉ EL TRADING ALGORITMICO ME DEVOLVIÓ EL CONTROL
subTitle:
Durante años fui el Bartleby de Melville. No porque me negara a trabajar, sino por esa inutilidad esencial de desgastarte en un sistema que no valora tu conocimiento y te reemplaza por alguien más joven en cuanto puede. Esa dinámica termina el día que decides tomar el control de cómo quieres pasar el resto de tu vida haciendo dinero.
Estaba en la jaula de un trabajo ordinario de 8 a 6, sintiendo cómo un sistema gris me devoraba lentamente. Cuando decidí dar el salto hacia el trading —bajo mi alter ego, Bookbinder— no lo hice persiguiendo la promesa del dinero fácil. 
Lo hice por el verdadero sueño latinoamericano: soberanía absoluta. Quería trabajar a solas, desde cualquier lugar, sin jefes, sin horarios impuestos y sin burocracias rancias dictándome cómo o cuándo recibir mi dinero
Al principio, caí en la misma trampa que todos. Estudié velas, indicadores, patrones, ciclos de mercado y psicología. Tenía decenas de piezas sueltas en la mesa, pero nadie te enseña cómo engranarlas en un método real. El marketing tradicional del trading te convence de que el problema eres tú: te dicen que tu cerebro animal te sabotea, que te falta disciplina o que un simple stop loss es tu salvavidas.
Pero esa era apenas la punta del iceberg.
Al vivir con neurodivergencia, mi cerebro no procesa las matemáticas de forma convencional; el espacio y el tiempo no se mueven en un plano cartesiano lineal dentro de mi cabeza. Intentar hacer trading manual (discrecional) frente a una pantalla en vivo era una tortura. Me di cuenta de que operar así es como ser un mecánico aficionado intentando reparar un auto con alambres mientras compites en la Fórmula 1 contra grandes instituciones, fondos y algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial.
Ahí entendí una verdad que casi nadie debate en público: el trading sistemático es la única forma de sobrevivir sin destruir tu salud mental.
Cuando traduces tus ideas a reglas estrictas y las sometes a algoritmos, eliminas la necesidad de tomar decisiones en caliente. Pero al dar ese paso, choqué contra las dos grandes paredes de este negocio:
1.La falta de un método científico para validar si una idea realmente funciona. El trabajo aburrido, largo y agotador de probar reglas hasta encontrar una ventaja estadística real (edge).
2.La mayoría pierde años buscando estrategias complejas o copiando sistemas ajenos que nunca se adaptan a su realidad. No se trataba de adivinar el futuro, sino de construir tus propias reglas operativas y pasarlas por un filtro matemático SIN EMOCIONES que te diga la verdad antes de arriesgar tu pellejo: ¿Esto tiene probabilidad de sobrevivir en el tiempo, o te va a arruinar?
Toda esta búsqueda tiene un costo altísimo: operativo, mental y físico. Y seamos honestos: a medida que pasa el tiempo, dispones de menos años para lograr ser rentable. La rentabilidad exige tiempo y capital, y no todos pueden darse el lujo de pasar cinco años aprendiendo programación y estadística desde cero para luego crear la experiencia que finalmente te dirá si puedes dejar tu trabajo de 6 a 8.
Por eso decidí convertir mi propio dolor en una herramienta. Actualmente estoy desarrollando una aplicación diseñada para hacer ese trabajo pesado por ti: analizar tus reglas, validar si tienen ventaja estadística real y darte una dirección objetiva —o una reestructuración— cuando tu sistema no funciona.
No vengo a venderte humo ni fórmulas secretas. Sigo construyendo mi propia consistencia en el laboratorio real: los mercados, un algoritmo a la vez, paso a paso, demostrando que la matemática no miente. Si estás cansado de operar desde expectativas falsas que te han vendido de hacerte rico en pocos días y quieres empezar a validar tus reglas con rigor, y tener una dirección clara sobre cómo construir tus propias estrategias, acompáñame en este proceso.

Title: Just talked about tokenized assets the other day, and now Solana is stepping up its speed too

Solana has raised its speed to 200 milliseconds in October, putting $500 million in tokenized assets in the spotlight.

Just the other day, I posted about tokenized assets becoming increasingly concentrated in the hands of a few. Now the Solana Foundation has shared progress on its October upgrade. It mainly involved two things: first, cutting the target block time from 300 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds; and second, making it easier for tokenized assets to move around on-chain. What does 200 milliseconds mean? It’s roughly the time it takes to confirm a tip to a streamer—more than 100 times faster than Bitcoin. The $500 million in tokenized assets refers to things like NFTs that can be traded and borrowed against directly on the Solana chain, without having to move them to Ethereum as before. That’s like building a small ecosystem of its own for Solana, so it doesn’t always have to shop elsewhere. In a report published on November 6, the Foundation emphasized that these two upgrades will make the chain cheaper and faster.

Impact on the market
- Short term: SOL is sure to attract investors’ attention, since increased speed directly affects the experience of using Solana. That gives it a competitive edge over traditional heavyweights like Bitcoin. ETH is rising now, too, and if SOL can keep pace, it could be a bright spot among tech stocks.
- Medium term: If this speed boost can bring in more applications—such as games, social platforms, and DeFi—then SOL’s standing could rise even further. After all, speed is what the crypto market needs most right now. Bitcoin and Ethereum already dominate the fast-moving sectors, so Solana needs to offer something different.

My take
I see a short-term opportunity for Solana, mainly because its speed advantage is getting renewed attention. But as for whether it can outperform BTC and ETH, I think it’ll take at least another year. SOL is currently hovering around $90, right at the midpoint between this year’s resistance and support levels. If it breaks above $95 on strong volume, things could get interesting. That said, cryptocurrencies are highly unpredictable, and blockchain technology lacks the fundamentals of the real economy. Take this with a grain of salt—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself.

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year works out to 12x; steadily earning 10% a month,
works out to 30x over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable feature—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are waited for; discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week”; set it as “make zero major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their principal are qualified to keep playing.
